original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃博拉患者横跨三国未被发现引发质疑
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一名40岁肯尼亚商人感染埃博拉后，在刚果（金）多地就医未被诊断，随后经乌干达飞抵肯尼亚内罗毕，成为肯尼亚首例确诊病例，两天后于10月5日死亡。非洲疾控中心重建其近六周行程，显示多国卫生筛查存在漏洞。刚果（金）今年已有超4000人死于埃博拉。

key_facts.fact: 一名40岁肯尼亚商人感染埃博拉后横跨三国未被发现
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Kenyan businessman was able to spend time in one of the regions worst-affected by Ebola, then travel to two more countries before his illness was identified.

key_facts.fact: 该患者成为肯尼亚首例确诊病例，两天后于10月5日死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The 40-year-old - who was only diagnosed with the deadly infectious disease after arriving seriously ill at a Nairobi hospital - became Kenya's first confirmed case. He died two days later on 5 October.

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）今年已有超4000人死于埃博拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo this year, in what is the second most deadly known outbreak to date.

key_facts.fact: 患者于10月3日在恩德培国际机场登机飞往内罗毕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he travelled by road to the capital, Kampala, and then Entebbe International Airport, where he boarded a flight to Nairobi on 3 October.

key_facts.fact: 乌干达官员称其通过机场筛查时体温正常
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ugandan officials said his temperature was normal when he passed through airport screening.

uncertainties: 患者具体感染时间和地点尚不清楚
尚不清楚患者过境乌干达时是否经过官方卫生检查站
调查人员正在核查其药物是否可能抑制了体温
其在基桑加尼接受治疗的医院和用药情况不明
